reason: Statement and strategy examined: the support of a section is defined by nonvanishing germs, and the three consistency facts (support closed in the open domain, empty support exactly when the section vanishes, restriction compatibility) follow from the germ and stalk definitions together with the published lemma that a section vanishes when all its germs vanish. Dependencies examined: def-presheaf-on-topological-space, def-stalk-of-presheaf, def-germ-of-section, lem-section-zero-if-all-germs-zero. Sources: Stacks Modules Definition 5.1 (tag 01AT) with Lemma 5.2 (tag 01AU); Schapira SS10.2. Choice-free definitional record.
